definitions.gloss: colloquial name, popular name, common name, nickname
definitions.explanation: An informal or commonly used name for something, as opposed to its official or formal designation. Used for places, laws, phenomena, and other things that have both formal and informal names.

examples.japanese: これは{俗称|ぞくしょう}で、{正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}は{別|べつ}にある。
examples.english: This is a colloquial name — the official name is different.

examples.japanese: この{法律|ほうりつ}は{俗称|ぞくしょう}で「マイナンバー{法|ほう}」と{呼|よ}ばれている。
examples.english: This law is commonly known as the 'My Number Act.'

examples.japanese: {国会議事堂|こっかいぎじどう}{前|まえ}の{通|とお}りは{俗称|ぞくしょう}で「{桜|さくら}{通|どお}り」と{呼|よ}ばれているが、{正式|せいしき}には{別|べつ}の{名前|なまえ}がある。
examples.english: The street in front of the National Diet Building is colloquially called 'Sakura-dori,' but it officially has a different name.

notes:
Compound of {俗|ぞく} (popular, common) + {称|しょう} (name, title). Used to identify informal names in contrast to official designations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {俗称|ぞくしょう}で{呼|よ}ぶ (to call by a common name)
- {俗称|ぞくしょう}で{知|し}られる (to be known by a colloquial name)
- {正式名称|せいしきめいしょう}と{俗称|ぞくしょう} (official name and colloquial name)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {俗称|ぞくしょう}: informal or commonly used name (neutral tone)
- {通称|つうしょう}: commonly used name, alias (similar but broader; can be semi-official)
- {愛称|あいしょう}: nickname, pet name (affectionate)
- {略称|りゃくしょう}: abbreviation, shortened name
